message.content: A fitted velvet blazer in deep emerald green (#0a5c5c) with a tailored shoulder cut and single-button closure, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in black wool crepe (#111111) featuring a relaxed fit through the hip. Underneath, a silk blouse in ivory with a subtle sheen and a modest V-neckline made of smooth charmeuse fabric (#FFFFF0), tucked neatly into the trousers. On feet, pointed-toe pumps in polished black leather with a 7cm heel, offering both elegance and stability for dining. Accessories include dangling gold hoops that complement her hair tone, a slim velvet clutch in matching emerald green, and a delicate diamond stud earring set in white gold to catch the low light of an autumn evening without overwhelming the outfit's refined silhouette. This ensemble balances smart sophistication with formal polish, perfect for an upscale New Year's restaurant celebration while respecting her refusal of overly tight fits or loud patterns. The rich velvet texture of the blazer adds warmth and luxury against the frosty season, while the monochromatic base elongates the figure elegantly. It allows her to feel confident and festive without breaking any dress code constraints or ignoring her preference for refined textures.
